data.description:
PLACEHOLDER EPIC (needs /dso:brainstorm to scope into stories). 

Motivation: PR #696's 'Ticket tests (alpine-busybox)' job failed at container-init pulling alpine:3.19 from Docker Hub (registry-1.docker.io: context deadline exceeded) — a transient infra flake, tests never ran, fixed only by a manual re-run. Root cause: ticket-platform-matrix.yml uses 'container: alpine:3.19', so the runner pulls from Docker Hub BEFORE any step runs — an unretriable single point of flake.

Guiding principle (generalize the 588e tristate discipline to CI infra): separate OBSERVABLY-TRANSIENT failures (self-heal via retry) from REAL failures (fail closed). Reuse the PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE lattice pattern (review-tristate-lib.sh / review-tristate-lattice.md) as a shared, conservative transient-classifier.

Layered plan (cheapest/highest-leverage first):
A. Shrink the flake surface (root cause): mirror alpine:3.19 -> GHCR digest-pinned (container: ghcr.io/<org>/alpine-busybox@sha256:...) via a scheduled refresh workflow; OR drop the container: key and exec the shell in a retry-wrapped docker run step (nick-fields/retry, exp backoff). docker/login-action helps rate-limits but not timeouts.
B. Make the pull retriable where container: is retained.
C. Self-healing auto-rerun ('CI medic'): a workflow_run-triggered job that classifies failed-job logs and, ONLY on a positive transient signature, runs 'gh run rerun --failed' (cap 2, auditable annotation per rerun). Signatures: 'context deadline exceeded', 'registry-1.docker.io', 'Docker pull failed', 'TLS handshake timeout', HTTP 429/5xx, 'runner received a shutdown signal', 'Failed to download action'.
D. SAFETY BOUNDARY (load-bearing): self-healing must NEVER mask a real failure. The classifier fails toward REAL on any ambiguity (FAIL-is-bottom, mirroring the I-1 guard + c9e9 rc!=0->fail-closed); retries only on a positive specific transient signature (never 'retry any red'); never re-runs a job whose log shows test-assertion failures; caps retries; logs every auto-rerun for audit.

Out of scope / open: cost/loop guards for auto-rerun; whether to centralize the classifier as a shared CI lib; GHCR auth/permissions. Scope via /dso:brainstorm before implementation.
data.title: CI infra resilience & self-healing: transient-failure auto-rerun + GHCR image mirror + shared transient-classifier
